## Pack builds reset creative candidate styles

- Work OS `1d239d80-aa2e-476e-892f-cb5d85892536`; worktree
  `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-pack-style-reset`, base
  `1263a033`, rebased onto `40207a95`.
- Live verification of the image guard (`44816719530`) failed before preview:
  creative repair exhausted its rounds, and the pack fallback failed contrast
  on `/services/` "Explore services" at 1.000:1 (`#33483c` on `#33483c`).
- Root cause: `services/[...overview].astro`, `services/[slug].astro`, and
  `locations/[slug].astro` statically import
  `src/generated-experiences/selected/styles.css`. That file contained the
  failed candidate's global `a { color: var(--ll-link, #33483c) }`, so a pack
  build restyled the pack CTA with brand text on its brand fill.
- Fix: pack and foundation builds temporarily replace that stylesheet with a
  no-op, build, and restore it via an EXIT trap. Creative builds are
  unchanged. CI `44899413833` passed before the rebase; 34 experience-pack
  tests pass and type checks are clean.
